name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task "Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off." specifies that the agent must toggle the siren switch only when a new ring begins (i.e., at the start of a ringing period). The provided clause uses `Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled)`, which applies to every step where `siren_ringing` holds, not just the start of a ring. This over‑generates the requirement and does not match the task wording. Replace the clause with one that triggers only at the start of ringing (e.g., a condition that detects the transition from not‑ringing to ringing) or otherwise constrain the rule to the start event. The machine should still be rule‑only, but the clause must reflect the start‑of‑ring condition.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The single hard clause Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) correctly captures the instruction to toggle the siren switch whenever the siren starts ringing. No hard goal clauses are required, so the rule‑only task warning is appropriate.

texts: Whenever the siren starts ringing, the agent must toggle the siren switch
machine:
